temporal_effect_characterization.interpretation: Effect magnitudes are characterized evidence only and are not converted into post-hoc acceptance thresholds.

single_remaining_scientific_blocker.name: ACTIVE_IRRIGATION_TEMPORAL_FIDELITY_REQUIREMENT
single_remaining_scientific_blocker.why_it_matters: Production admission requires an independently justified tolerance on a named hydrological/application output. Repository evidence now characterizes the numerical effect but cannot legitimately decide that the observed effect is acceptable.
valid_next_input: application-owner requirement for allowable temporal error in named outputs
independent validation authority with such a criterion
separately preregistered numerical-accuracy requirement justified independently of RM23-RM28 outcomes

nonclaims: No arbitrary Ribasim topology or competing-demand authority.
No active drainage in the triangle.
No active root uptake in the triangle.
No claim that RM28's small effect size is automatically negligible for every intended application.
No claim that the finest converged RM23 trajectory is exact.
No native Ribasim checkpoint API or production process-host architecture is admitted.
reopen_condition: Reopen only when an independent active-irrigation temporal-fidelity requirement is supplied, or when the intended application changes enough to require a newly preregistered fidelity contract. Do not reopen merely to add more numerical combinations.
